content:
BUILT CoLAB, as the coordinating entity of the Digital Construction Revolution Mobilising Project – REV@CONSTRUCTION, would like to invite you to its Interim Conference, held in person on Tuesday, 6 September, at 2:30pm, at the Centro Cultural de Vila Flor, in Guimarães.

The event's main theme will be "The Revolution of Digital Construction in Portugal", and it will be held during the week of the ISIC 2022 International Conference – International Society for Intelligent Construction Conference.

Participation is free of charge, but subject to registration here.

In addition to presenting the work carried out so far by the project's partners, this Interim Conference will also feature Eng. José Gomes Mendes, President of the Fundação Mestre Casais, as keynote speaker, as well as a round table on digitalisation in the AEC sector.

The agenda is as follows:

2:30pm – Opening
• António Cunha, President of CCDR-N
2:40pm – Project Status Update
• Hugo Sousa – BUILT CoLAB
• Francisco Reis – BIMMS
• João Vaz da Silva – 3Maps

3:55pm – Coffee Break

4:15pm – Keynote: "Digitalisation as a driver for the Revolution in the AEC Sector"
. José Gomes Mendes – Fundação Mestre Casais
4:35pm – Round Table: "The Impacts of Digitalisation on the Revolution of the Construction Sector"
. Francisco Reis – BIMMS
. José Gomes Mendes – Fundação Mestre Casais
. Luís Gomes – Mota-Engil
. Rita Moura – Teixeira Duarte
Moderated by Paulo Cruz – U. Minho
5:20pm – Closing
. Rita Moura – Teixeira Duarte
